title: Line driver
description: A large open triangle pointing right with one input.
tells: Big triangle, one input. The manual heads it 'Line driver', but the 75154 is a quadruple line RECEIVER in every datasheet found (TI 1974 and 1995, National DS75154), and sheet 2A50 uses it as a receiver; the manual's label is kept here as printed and taken to be a slip (see catalog/chips/75154.json).
